## Episode Thesis

This Friday panel was mostly about macro and politics, with almost no discussion of individual stocks. The panel saw the slow Swedish government formation as necessary but not critical for the economy. The Swedish economy is improving, with the growth forecast revised up, household confidence rising and industry still strong. The risks raised were energy policy, possible Riksbank rate hikes, the US 10-year yield at 5.35% hitting earnings eventually, debt risk tied to AI-driven investment, and France's state-budget crisis. Heading into Q3 reports, the guest expected mostly positive results but named automotive as a weak segment, citing Volvo Cars and Chinese competition.
